rotation.why.cotton_mono: Cotton every year: the common baseline under cotton cluster contracts, shown so the other options can be compared with it.
rotation.why.cotton_wheat: The standard cotton–wheat system. After the wheat harvest in June the field usually stays bare until cotton is sown the next spring.
rotation.why.cotton_wheat_mung: Cotton–wheat with a mung bean second crop (takroriy ekin) sown after the wheat harvest, so the field is covered in summer and a legume adds nitrogen.
rotation.why.alfalfa_cotton_wheat: The traditional soil-restoring rotation: three years of alfalfa add organic matter and nitrogen before cotton returns.
rotation.why.barley_sorghum: Suggested for saline or water-short fields: winter barley grows on winter and spring moisture, and sorghum is drought-tolerant and moderately salt-tolerant.
rotation.why.wheat_silage: For forage and livestock farms: silage maize sown after the wheat harvest gives a second feed harvest in the same year.
rotation.why.rainfed_wheat_chickpea: For rain-fed (lalmi) land: chickpea breaks the cereal cycle and, as a legume, adds nitrogen.
crop.reason.no_sowing_window: {crop}: the temperature never meets its sowing condition in the record.
crop.reason.temperature_limit: {crop}: the growing-season temperature ({temp} °C) is outside its comfortable range.
crop.reason.season_too_long: {crop}: the usual harvest comes {days} days after the date that is frost-free in 80 % of years.
crop.reason.ph_limit: {crop}: soil pH {ph} is outside its preferred range.
crop.reason.salinity_loss: {crop}: expected yield loss from soil salinity about {loss} % (Maas–Hoffman).
crop.warning.heat_window: {crop}: regional air temperature passed {threshold} °C during its sensitive stage in {share} % of years. Irrigated fields are usually cooler, so treat this as a warning only.

crop.reason.frost_after_sowing: {crop}: frost after sowing, while the crop is young, in {share} % of years.
crop.reason.steep_slope: {crop}: the slope ({slope} %) is too steep for furrow irrigation.
crop.gap.salinity_unknown: Salinity unknown — get a soil test.
crop.gap.salt_tolerance_unknown: {crop}: salt tolerance is not in our data yet.

rotation.excluded.crop_share: {crop} would be grown in {share} % of years; the contract asks for {required} %.
rotation.excluded.no_sowing_window: {crop}: the sowing condition is never met here.
